import ast, collections, csv, hashlib, io, json
from pathlib import Path
r=Path('/home/xingrui/bench/quantized_graph/research_20261025')
p=Path('/home/xingrui/workspace/quantized_graph/symphony_research_20261025/research/20261025/scripts/confirm78.py')
t=ast.parse(p.read_text())
assigns={n.targets[0].id:n.value for n in t.body if isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and len(n.targets)==1 and isinstance(n.targets[0],ast.Name)}
orders=ast.literal_eval(assigns['orders']);variants=ast.literal_eval(assigns['variants'])
assert len(orders)==4
assert all(len(order)==3 and set(order)==set(variants) for order in orders)
assert len({f'confirm78_r{i}_{condition}' for i,order in enumerate(orders) for condition in order})==12
assert all(sum(c in order for order in orders)==4 for c in variants)
ref=(r/'experiments/time65_control_pre/search_k10_r0_ids.csv').read_bytes()
learned=b''.join(line for line in (r/'experiments/screen78_independent_v1/search_k10_r0_ids.csv').read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True) if line.startswith(b'24000,'))
assert len(ref.splitlines())==len(learned.splitlines())==10000
REFERENCE_RESULTS=[]
for tag,data,expected_ef in [('baseline',ref,'20000'),('learned',learned,'24000')]:
    rows=list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(data.decode())))
    assert {row[0] for row in rows}=={expected_ef}
    REFERENCE_RESULTS.append({'condition':tag,'id_score_rows':len(rows),'first_csv_row':rows[0],'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()})
PROTOCOL_RESULTS={'planned_run_count':12,'planned_timing_row_count':24,'conditions_per_round':orders,'variants':variants,'position_counts':{c:dict(collections.Counter(order.index(c)+1 for order in orders)) for c in variants},'references':REFERENCE_RESULTS,'no_benchmark_executed':True}
